title: Texas electric grid moratorium won’t have big impact on BTC miners: Bernstein
summary: Monday’s announcement that Texas Governor Greg Abbott set a moratorium on approval of ERCOT-linked data centers pending an audit won’t impact miners’ approved electricity contracts.

title: Tether Gold reserves rise 9.5% as gold posts worst quarter in 13 years
summary: XAUt added to its bullion backing during gold’s worst quarter since 2013, as tokenized commodity holder counts continued to rise.

title: Italy’s biggest bank triples staked Ether ETF holdings while cutting IBIT shares
summary: Italy’s largest bank Intesa Sanpaolo increased its staked Ether ETF position to $7.1 million while reducing its holdings in two spot Bitcoin ETFs.

title: Jim Cramer plans to sell his Bitcoin over quantum fears as BTC rises 1.6%
summary: The CNBC personality said he’ll sell his Bitcoin holdings due to fears about quantum computing, as some cryptocurrency investors celebrated, referencing the popular “inverse Cramer” meme.

title: Former FBI supervisor admits guilt in $1M crypto theft
summary: A former FBI supervisory agent pleaded guilty to stealing about $1 million worth of digital assets from an adversarial country and forfeited about $925,000 in funds to government-controlled wallets.

title: Strategy’s STRC retakes $90 after 24% rebound from June closing low
summary: The preferred shares have recovered nearly 24% from their June closing low as Strategy builds its cash reserve and repurchases STRC.

title: US yen intervention puts Bitcoin, risk assets on notice for liquidity flux
summary: The first US-Japan joint yen intervention in 28 years came amid record bond yields and worries about the yen carry trade.

title: Apple briefly removes Telegram from App Store, Gram rebounds
summary: Apple restored Telegram after the messaging platform removed content that violated its child safety policies and banned the user who posted it.

title: NY judge denies CFTC motion to halt enforcement action against Kalshi
summary: The ruling leaves New York’s case against Kalshi in place while allowing the CFTC to renew its request before Judge Victor Marrero.

title: Nigeria sets crypto tax collection rules for digital asset platforms
summary: The framework specifies how existing tax obligations apply to crypto disposals and rewards, with some withheld amounts payable in the originating token.
